name: llm-wiki
description: Knowledge base management skills for the LLM Wiki pattern (Karpathy-style). Provides ingest (project manifest changes → wiki pages), query (cross-project inventory questions), lint (OKF v0.1 conformance, broken links, staleness detection), and sync (re-ingest stale pages). The KB lives at ~/.knowledge/ with a raw/wiki two-layer OKF v0.1 layout.
